view_switcher_surface_label: Example view-switcher posture for official voter-information routes
delivery_role_note: Bounded cross-view continuity surface for official voter-information routes that expose the same answer-bearing set through multiple views.

view_modes.state_affordance: The segmented view switcher shows List as the current mode in both visual styling and announced button state.
view_modes.carryover_note: Search terms, county scope, and open-now filter remain applied when the voter returns from map mode.
view_modes.parity_limit_note: The list shows the full scoped result set, including sites outside the current map viewport.
view_modes.recovery_note: The voter can return to this overview mode from map mode without losing the selected site.

view_modes.state_affordance: The segmented view switcher shows Map as an alternate mode before activation and as the current mode after explicit activation.
view_modes.carryover_note: The same search scope and selected site carry over into the map view.
view_modes.parity_limit_note: Markers cluster at low zoom; the route states that the list remains the full-set review path.
view_modes.recovery_note: A 'Back to list' control returns to the same selected site in the list view.

default_view_note: The route defaults to the list view because it is the most reviewable full-set presentation, but the map remains visibly available as an alternate presentation.
active_view_state_note: The current view is exposed clearly in both visual styling and programmatic state so the voter can tell which mode is active.
selection_semantics_note: This implementation uses a segmented toggle-button group rather than a tablist; the current view is exposed with pressed-state semantics on the active button.
activation_model_note: Changing views requires explicit activation; moving focus across the controls does not switch the visible result view.
cross_view_scope_carryover_note: Search terms, jurisdiction scope, and open-now state either carry across views or reset visibly with an explicit explanation.
cross_view_sort_filter_carryover_note: Any difference in ordering or filter behavior across views is disclosed in bounded form rather than inferred from the layout alone.
cross_view_current_item_note: When the voter switches views, the currently selected site remains re-findable rather than resetting to an unrelated default area or item.
parity_gap_note: Where a view cannot expose the full official set at once, the route says so and points to the reviewable full-set view.
compact_mobile_note: Small-screen layouts keep labels intelligible, preserve the active-view cue, and avoid hiding the state of the selected mode.
keyboard_and_screen_reader_note: Keyboard and assistive-technology users can inspect the available views, activate a new view deliberately, and understand the currently displayed mode.
recovery_and_overview_note: The route preserves an easy return to the most reviewable overview mode if the alternate view is inconvenient or less complete.
